mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_sla_work_item_request ( tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, request_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, channel VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, seller_account_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, item_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, conversation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, buyer_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, work_item_id BIGINT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, idempotency_key), UNIQUE KEY uk_cs_sla_work_item_request_id (request_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_sla_result_inbox ( event_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, request_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, payload_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, disposition VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, received_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (event_id), INDEX idx_cs_sla_result_inbox_request (request_id) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_sla_work_item_result ( request_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, work_item_id BIGINT NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, scope VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, outcome VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, content VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, recorded_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, recorded_at VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (request_id) )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id, channel, seller_account_id, item_id, conversation_id, buyer_id, work_item_id, created_at, updated_at FROM cs_sla_work_item_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id, channel, seller_account_id, item_id, conversation_id, buyer_id, work_item_id, created_at, updated_at FROM cs_sla_work_item_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id, channel, seller_account_id, item_id, conversation_id, buyer_id, work_item_id, created_at, updated_at FROM cs_sla_work_item_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, updated_at DESC, request_id DESC LIMIT 1
